standing: DRAFT - PROPOSED, TEST-ONLY: our proposal of the simplest representative configuration for High Press Escape (A02-HPE1), for Christian's approval; not knowledge, not approved, never served. Read only by the TEST-ONLY PROPOSED loader (back/src/system/derivation/draft-store.ts loadProposedRealization), in unit tests; no route reads it, and nothing here is in contracts.json, corpus-restatements.json, provisional-realizations.json or learning-goal-authorizations.json.
about: Stage B1 of the A02 complete-activity package (12 November 2026), on Christian's reply received 12 November 2026, item 6. HPE-1: GF2 played in blocks; one team escapes and one presses (N3); one line marked across the full width near the escaping team's end, placed by a qualitative rule, its 12 m only a schematic number (N1, ILLUSTRATIVE); the escaping team scores by entering the region beyond that line under the approved condition (our CANDIDATE restatement in a02-composition); the pressing team scores only by winning the ball and dribbling it over the escaping team's end line (N2 (a)), its own event, so the condition stays on the escaping team's score only (measured, probe P0: GA-ROLE-EVENTS, a role scoring by its own event takes no condition of the primary event). Every item is AUTHORED so it establishes what it proposes, and its category, stamped by the loader, says what it is: PROPOSED (ILLUSTRATIVE for the schematic distance). No library constraint, no environmental manipulation (K2's empty set stands), no participant placement, no START or restart item (GF2's own start stays the coach's choice), no departure from the Laws (LAW-11 is Christian's question Q3, built in a later stage).

questions.asks: N3 and N1: for the first A02 activity, one team escapes and one presses for a block (the coach swaps roles), with one line across the area near the escaping team's end placed by a rule, not a distance (where the pressing team, working together near that end, can just cover the width, with room beyond to receive and keep the ball), and the escaping team scoring once the ball gets past it
questions.askedFor: "Please propose the simplest representative configuration that makes the relevant defensive pressure and escape target observable to the coach." (received 12 November 2026)

questions.asks: N2: what the pressing team wins: (a) after winning the ball, dribbling it over the escaping team's end line (built); (b) a goal on that line; or (c) a point for a controlled regain short of the line
questions.askedFor: "I want to see where coordinated pressure comes from, how players encounter information about that pressure, what genuine escape opportunities exist, and how the game's consequences make successful solutions meaningful." (received 12 November 2026)

realization.note: PROPOSED, for Christian's approval.
